fuente.titulo: Pope Leo XIV mourns lives lost in shooting in Krakow, Poland

titular: Pope Leo mourns victims of Krakow shooting
bajada: Six killed, fifteen injured in Poland's Main Market Square; Pope offers prayers and urges peace
caption: Pope Leo XIV expressed deep sorrow following a shooting in Krakow's Main Market Square that left six people dead and fifteen injured. In a message of condolence, he assured victims' families of his prayers and spiritual closeness, and called for renewed efforts to pursue peace and harmony in the face of violence. Source: Vatican News, Nov 8, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A quiet candlelight vigil in a European city square at dusk, flowers and candles on the cobblestones, with a church spire visible in the upper right third, left and center open
